text:
nora-sales: Clara from TenantCorp reports POC stream shows JSON parse error and stops mid-sentence.
clara-tenant: during the walkthrough the transcript cut off and the console logged "Unexpected end of JSON input". Happens ~8s in.
jia-eng: can you paste raw SSE fragments or gateway dump? need to confirm missing trailing blank line.
clara-tenant: DM'd a short capture. Excerpt:
``
event: message
data: {"id":"t1","text":"Order number 4"
data: {"id":"t1","text":"5 has shipped"}

# then socket closed
```
mike-sre: infra logs show worker-9 had `oom-kill` ~3m earlier and `write() returned -1, errno 104` at the demo time. Likely generator died mid-write leaving an incomplete SSE event.
sdk-bot: client tip: buffer SSE `data:` lines until you see a blank line (`

`) before JSON.parse. On parse failure, wait for next chunk and retry once. I'll DM a 3-line snippet.
jia-eng: short-term: give demo the SDK buffer snippet. Infra: I'll bump memory headroom and disable the cron that spiked allocations; will canary a hotfix.
mike-sre: deploy-bot: starting canary deploy infra/worker-pool-memory-fix @1899000038. Canary=2 nodes.
clara-tenant: applying client buffer now to continue demo. ETA on infra fix?
jia-eng: canary healthy at 1899000059, no truncations in test runs; full rollout in ~8m.
nora-sales: thanks team, telling Clara to pause for 10min and retry after rollout.
clara-tenant: retried after canary, stream completed cleanly. No parse errors. Great support. :thumbsup:
